title: Spectroscopy-informed deep learning identifies Little Red Dot candidates in JWST imaging
summary: A cross-modal machine-learning framework combined matched NIRCam imaging and NIRSpec/PRISM spectroscopy to identify Little Red Dots from imaging alone. Applied to spectroscopically observed high-redshift galaxies previously classified as non-LRDs, it found 35 new candidates; 10 of the 13 with medium- or high-resolution grating spectra show broad H-alpha emission. Applied to public NIRCam imaging it yielded 357 and 23 additional candidates in three survey datasets. The abstract suggests current color-selected samples may miss part of the LRD diversity; candidates are not confirmed spectroscopically beyond the 13.
